pageTitle: Ajji's Courtyard Adventures — Back to Roots

program.title: Ajji's Courtyard Adventures
program.description: Step into a world of mud pies, games, seeds & stories just like Ajji's good old days. Craft, plant & play the natural way with guided activities rooted in tradition and wonder.

items.title: Mud & Makers
items.description: Hands on clay and mud play encouraging sensory exploration, simple sculpting and cooperative building.

items.title: Seed Planting
items.description: Plant seeds in small pots and learn about growth, care, and cycles of nature children take a sapling home.

items.title: Stories with Ajji
items.description: Story circles with folk tales, songs and simple rhymes that connect children to cultural memory.

items.title: Craft & Play
items.description: Nature inspired craft sessions using grains, leaves and safe materials to create keepsakes.

items.label: What to bring
items.value: Sun hat, water bottle, a change of clothes
